blocks.what_we_do:
Download and extract the whole source project. Follow these actions:

1. Download [GWAS_course-2026.1.zip](https://github.com/mgentiluomo/GWAS_training_session/releases/download/project-2026.1/GWAS_course-2026.1.zip) from release `project-2026.1`. This fixed version contains the course project, not the encrypted data.
2. On Windows, right-click the ZIP and choose "Extract All", then "Extract". On macOS, double-click the ZIP. On Linux, use your file manager to extract it.
3. Extract it under `C:/` on Windows or your home folder on macOS and Linux. The ZIP supplies its own `GWAS_course` folder. The standard paths are `C:/GWAS_course` and `~/GWAS_course`.
4. Open that folder. You should see `config.R`, `GWAS_course.Rproj` and the folders `R`, `lessons` and `scripts`.

Keep the whole folder together. You may use another writable location or folder name. Do not nest a second copy of the project inside it.

If you already use Git, a plain `git clone https://github.com/mgentiluomo/GWAS_training_session.git` also works. Its default branch is `course/2026-guided-training`. The default folder name `GWAS_training_session` is valid. Open `GWAS_course.Rproj` inside it; no folder or branch rename is needed.
blocks.why: The source project contains code and text. The encrypted data are separate and are downloaded at step 0.7. One project folder keeps the relative paths consistent.
blocks.you_need: R and RStudio from steps 0.1 and 0.2, an internet connection and a folder where you can save files.
blocks.command: No R code to run. Download and extract the whole project as described above.
blocks.expected_result: The project folder contains `config.R`, `GWAS_course.Rproj`, `R`, `lessons` and `scripts`. The standard folder is `C:/GWAS_course` on Windows or `~/GWAS_course` on macOS and Linux. Other writable folder names also work.
blocks.troubleshooting: If `config.R` is missing, check that you opened the extracted project folder. Do not use a single downloaded notebook. Do not create an empty replacement file or rename a downloaded HTML page to `.R`.
blocks.quick_check:
Does downloading the source project also download the encrypted classroom data?

<details><summary>Show the answer</summary>No. Download the matching data at step 0.7.</details>
